purpose: Disprove site-native discovery cheaply before query-scale work.

assumptions.assumption: Enough important corpus domains expose legitimate usable discovery mechanisms.
assumptions.cheapest_test: For 15-20 corpus-share/language-stratified domains, inspect robots.txt, the home page, declared search forms, and at most two conventional public discovery endpoints.
assumptions.pass_condition: Native-search mechanisms collectively represent at least 10% of corpus rows, or a strategically valuable language/source class representing at least 5% has a usable specialist mechanism.
assumptions.fail_condition: Native-search mechanisms represent under 10% of corpus rows and no strategically valuable specialist group reaches 5%.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Classify G0 as WEAK and stop before Stage 1; still publish the 97-domain source map.

assumptions.assumption: URLs returned by usable mechanisms map unambiguously to links_corpus.parquet.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Map up to five article-like returned URLs per usable mechanism using exact and conservative normalized lookup.
assumptions.pass_condition: At least 30% map exactly or conservatively, with no more than 5% ambiguous mappings.
assumptions.fail_condition: Fewer than 10% map, or ambiguity exceeds 5%.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Disable the mechanism; do not compensate with speculative canonicalization.

assumptions.assumption: Discovery results expose individual content pages rather than only categories, tags, or search pages.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Classify the small mapping-probe result set by URL pattern and official-corpus membership.
assumptions.pass_condition: At least 60% of returned candidate URLs are article/content-like and at least one maps to an official row.
assumptions.fail_condition: Fewer than 30% are article/content-like, or none maps to the official corpus.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Reclassify as SITEMAP or CATEGORY_INDEX, not NATIVE_SEARCH, and exclude it from query experiments.

assumptions.assumption: Discovery can be automated conservatively without CAPTCHA, payment, authentication, or bypass.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Make no more than four slow requests per selected domain and record status, challenge markers, and rate-limit behavior.
assumptions.pass_condition: The mechanism responds without CAPTCHA/payment/authentication and without repeated 403/429/challenge responses.
assumptions.fail_condition: Use requires payment, login, CAPTCHA, private API reverse-engineering, or repeated blocking.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Mark BLOCKED and stop requests to that domain.

assumptions.assumption: Results are not merely a tiny repeated set of popular pages.
assumptions.cheapest_test: For mechanisms passing mapping, compare returned URL uniqueness across two cheap deterministic medical probes.
assumptions.pass_condition: At least 50% of mapped rows are unique and no single page contributes over 25% of mapped rows.
assumptions.fail_condition: Unique ratio is below 25% or one page contributes over 50%.

assumptions.assumption: Language mismatch can be handled without a closed LLM or large new model.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Audit project and user model caches plus installed packages before any download; estimate size/runtime for any candidate open MT model.
assumptions.pass_condition: A suitable cached model exists, or an open model under 1 GB preferred/2 GB hard cap works without changing CUDA/PyTorch.
assumptions.fail_condition: Only closed, paid, incompatible, or over-2-GB paths are available.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Do not download; test only deterministic native-language branches that are available and label the rest UNTESTED.

assumptions.assumption: Request count and runtime remain reasonable.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Project request counts from passing adapters before Stage 1 and again before Stage 2.
assumptions.pass_condition: Stage 0 stays at or below 70 requests; projected Stage 1 stays at or below 2400 requests and four hours at the configured rate.
assumptions.fail_condition: A stage exceeds its request cap or measured rate projects beyond four hours for Stage 1.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Do not scale; narrow only by disabling failed endpoints, never by increasing concurrency.

assumptions.assumption: Usable query search covers a meaningful share of official corpus rows, rather than many tiny domains.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Weight passing NATIVE_SEARCH domains by their exact official corpus row counts; report sitemap/category coverage separately.
assumptions.pass_condition: G0 STRONG at 30% or more, PARTIAL at 10-30%, or PARTIAL_SPECIALIST for a justified source/language class of at least 5%.
assumptions.fail_condition: G0 WEAK below 10% with no qualifying specialist class.
assumptions.action_if_failed: Stop before Stage 1 and recommend acquisition by source map rather than query-scale site search.

G2.interpretation: Only recommend 1200-query scaling if candidate value is operationally meaningful and fits local resources.
